subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative SDK-error tests as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI decrypt error, or continue requiring organic after-fix Grok/gateway proof?
rationale: Automation cannot create a faithful xAI model/key rotation event, and the contributor cannot deterministically induce the exact code-less provider error without exercising a different error path.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: Treat the redacted production logs plus focused predicate coverage as sufficient for this provider-side trigger and continue normal merge review.

options.title: Require organic after-fix proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real xAI/Grok rotation event produces redacted gateway logs showing the stripped retry succeeds.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and pause this PR if maintainers want a broader provider-error classification design instead of the narrow recovery predicate.

recommendation.title: Accept proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the redacted production logs plus focused predicate coverage as sufficient for this provider-side trigger and continue normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the existing Responses retry predicate and prior proof decisions for encrypted reasoning recovery.
